prompt: A tank holding 240 litres is filled by a tap delivering 8 litres per minute. A drain removes 3 litres per minute. Both run for the first 20 minutes, after which the drain is closed. How many minutes does it take in total to fill the tank?
trap_note: Two phases: 20 minutes at a net 5 l/min fills 100 litres, and the remaining 140 litres take 140/8 = 17.5 minutes, so 37.5 in total. Treating the net rate as lasting the whole fill gives 240/5 = 48 -- the phase change is the step a short chain drops.
source: authored for M1-5 (2026-09-11) after all four declared traps reproduced 0/5
